description: This file defines the 'Information' model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to retrieve information records, their layouts, and related data from the database.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Model class for handling information records in Opencart, including methods to fetch individual information, list of informations, and layout IDs.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific information record by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Retrieves all active information records, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID associated with a specific information record.
